name: Stouching Robotics
summary: Stouching Robotics develops tactile sensors and data acquisition hardware for robotic manipulation and embodied AI training. Its portfolio includes optical tactile sensors, a tactile gripper, wearable capture devices and portable UMI data collection equipment.
